Name: NPC oveRidea Kyouka English
Author: Usmovers02
Description:
This MOD is an english translation of the fan-made NPC MOD for the vtuber [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27073?tab=description]Zhang Jinghau[/url] made by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/beixijun/about-me?gameId=1303]Beixijun[/url]. Please make sure to endorse the original mod.

﻿[img]https://images-wixmp-ed30a86b8c4ca887773594c2.wixmp.com/f/ffd5c585-86f7-41f0-a400-adfa971562e6/di5ptck-3209c9da-0aa7-4956-98cf-6bf6dc800c59.jpg/v1/fill/w_884,h_442,q_75,strp/20240912145330_1_by_usmovers02_di5ptck-fullview.jpg?token=eyJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9..Gg2Eu4Q07FcTI7LHJTDGtyddltd-5w_DiqUoC1t_gnk[/img]

[Character  Information]
Name: Jinghua
Birthday: Summer 6th

[Gift Tastes]
Loved items: diamonds, gold ingots, spicy eel, juice, rice pudding, ice cream, pink cake, sashimi sushi, ginger ale
Liked items: gems, poppies, gold ore, and golden eggs
Disliked items: eggs
Hated Items: coffee, triple espresso, energy tonic water // will think of the pain of overtime, rabbit's feet // Jinghua feels that this thing is a bit scary
Neutral: resins, fish, sea foam pudding

[Schedule]
Rainy days, He will go to the bar to drink at 4 pm
Spring, He will go out at 8 am to take pictures at the lake below Leah's house
Summer, He will go out at 8 am to the ice cream stand and go to the beach at 1 pm
Autumn At 8am, He will go to the park to take pictures.
In winter, He will go to the museum to read books at 10am.

[Events]
Zero Heart: Enter the bus station between 6am and 6pm
Two Heart: Enter Pelican Town between 3pm and 7pm
Four Heart: Go out between 6am and 12pm
Six Heart: Enter the Secret Forest between 8am and 6pm
Eight Heart: Receive a letter first. Please enter Pelican Town between 6am and 12pm after reading it
Ten Heart: Enter the beach between 8pm and 12pm
Twelve Heart: Receive a letter first. Please enter the hot spring bath after 8pm after reading it

[Movie preferences]
Like Chocolate Popcorn Ice Cream Sandwich French Fries
General Apple Crisp Black Licorice Marshmallow Jasmine Tea Cappuccino Mousse Cake
Dislike Hummus Snack Pack Big Sugar Ball

*Translator note*
This is my first attempt at modding Stardew Valley in any way at all. I have tested the zero heart event, Jinghau's 6AM location, talking to him and gifting him. I'm still learning about effective ways to quickly test the entirety of NPC mods. I very well may have messed up some of the original mod while translating. Please let me know about any bugs you encounter.

Also the original mod assumes the farmer is a woman. There are some areas in the data where I was able to make gender neutral dialogue or add an option for both feminine and masculine dialogue but I don't yet have the skill to do that everywhere. If you're playing as a man there WILL be moments where you're called a woman.
